authorship: Specific gates are independently authored experiment design; not requester definitions and not retrieval-derived.

all_of: visible crisp white shirt beneath robe
deep-red tie with gold diagonal stripes
knitted scarf around shoulders with broad alternating deep-red and gold bands
gates.fail_if: Any component absent or differently related; a robe alone is partial and FAIL.

all_of: aged brown fabric with visible seams or patches
broad floppy brim plus crooked tapering crown
two eye hollows and mouth crease physically formed by folds on the hat itself
hat rests fully visible on adjacent pedestal
gates.fail_if: Face painted or external, ordinary smooth wizard hat, or partial bundle.

all_of: candles occupy free air at different heights with clear gaps beneath and no visible load-bearing support
visible star-filled indoor vault above heavy stone arches
gates.fail_if: Candles stand on surfaces or stars only in an ordinary window; partial relationship is FAIL.

all_of: slender tapered wooden wand in her left-hand grip beside shoulder
light begins visibly at wand tip
light continues into sparse constellation above that same shoulder
illumination touches the fingers nearest tip
gates.fail_if: Disconnected nearby glow, wand hidden, or constellation without origin/contact relation.

all_of: short dark bob and airy separated bangs
similar dark almond eye shape and gently arched brows
similar small soft-rounded nose and full lips
gates.fail_if: Observable features replaced by a generic unrelated face; required feature occlusion is UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS.
